sources.snippet: RicardoEstep/RPBizkit-v7-12B is a 12.2 billion parameter experimental language model built upon the Mistral Nemo architecture. It leverages a sophisticated five-part "Model Stock" merging process, utilizing Mergekit to combine and filter various base models.
